images.name: top
images.prompt: Revise this top-down farm concept. Preserve overall art style, long block, central curved railway, red barn and twin silos EAST/right middle third, water tower and workshops WEST/left middle third. SWAP the northeast farmhouse/orchard with the northwest cornfield: farmhouse and its raised orchard now UPPER LEFT / WEST of tracks. Its broad porch faces EAST/right toward railway, opposite barn. Basement, attic, retaining wall, winding drive, tire swing and apple trees retained around relocated house. Upper right becomes corn. ALL corn becomes TWICE AS TALL (about 3.6-4 metres) and extremely DENSE lush overlapping broad leaves, near-solid sight-blocking crop canopies. Thin walking paths cut through dense crop, no sparse sticks with visible soil between every plant. Keep lower fields both sides, ditch and bridge right of track. Camera directly overhead, portrait. Update label farmhouse+orchard to upper LEFT. Concept only, no game UI.

images.name: house
images.prompt: Revise farm concept to relocated house WEST of railway, front porch facing EAST toward track and opposite red barn. Landscape wide 3D view from south looking north along tracks near centre. White two-full-storey farmhouse with attic and cellar on LEFT of tracks, raised apple orchard, low retaining wall and winding drive on LEFT. Red barn and paired silos on RIGHT of tracks in middle distance. Strong unmistakable separation by railway, not house and barn on same side. Preserve low-poly pixel textures, warm porch lamp, apple crates, tire swing and inviting spooky dusk. Corn beside approach is TWICE original height about 3.6-4m, thick overlapping leaves hide through-sightlines, narrow paths only. No text, no characters.

images.name: corn
images.prompt: Revise into a low eye-level 3D feature concept showing MUCH TALLER MUCH THICKER corn. Camera on narrow walking path beside shallow ditch and timber footbridge, corn towers 3.6-4 metres high, TWICE original height, dense layered broad green leaves from knee height to tassels; nearly impossible to see THROUGH crop. Corn plants tightly packed not sparse poles. Corn foliage fills foreground right and part left, narrow deliberate path opening frames red barn loft and hoist, hay pyramid and paired silos middle distance RIGHT/EAST of railway. Railway on left-midground divides farm; relocate white two-storey farmhouse + attic and raised apple orchard to far LEFT/WEST across tracks, not beside barn. Keep all rich low-poly pixelated Quackville art, dusk lighting, broken fence/tractor only if visible through clearing. Emphasize immersive enclosing corn corridor while keeping bridge/path readable. No text.
